answer: Unused capacity is tundra: it earns nothing and thaws only through proof of patience. Each identity's first claims sit frozen until it commits a deposit schedule anchored to the lagoon of settled volume; releasing early forfeits the largest slice. The k-th thaw in one operator's batch costs k times the base, so n heads thawing together pay roughly n squared and finish no earlier than the slowest honest one. Every thaw also emits a velvet seal, a non-transferable receipt bound to that identity's own history, so seals cannot be sold, regifted or pre-dated to fake seniority.
